Add per-tier Bugsink error-tracker instance hosting, converging on the OpenObserve VPS pattern (one small OVH VPS per tier; Cloudflare-proxied `errors.<tier domain>` exposing only the Sentry-protocol DSN ingest routes; UI and REST API reachable exclusively over an SSH tunnel to loopback).

New `observability bugsink` command group: `provision` (OVH VPS from `cloud-init-bugsink.yaml`), `deploy` (hash-locked `--require-hashes` venv install from the committed `bugsink_requirements.txt`, the vendored `bugsink_conf.py` settings module, rendered EnvironmentFile / caddy gate / origin firewall, then a loopback readiness poll through first-boot migrations), and `provision-projects` (mints a REST token via `bugsink-manage` over SSH and get-or-creates the team + per-service projects through an SSH tunnel, emitting the DSN-to-Vault-key map). The generic `dns` / `list` / `destroy` commands are shared with the OpenObserve flow.
